title: Implication for the Terminal Property
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine, let $C$ be a configuration, let $T$ be a natural number, and let $\mathrm{box}$, $Q$, and $Q'$ be properties of configurations. Suppose all runs from $C$ of length at most $T$ end in configurations satisfying $\mathrm{box}$, and every run of length exactly $T$ ends in a halted configuration satisfying $Q$. If every configuration satisfying $Q$ also satisfies $Q'$, then every run of length exactly $T$ ends in a halted configuration satisfying $Q'$, and all runs of length at most $T$ still satisfy $\mathrm{box}$.
